reason: I only buy software after another owner I know uses it, and here only 1 to 5 companies pay and there are no references. $89 a month is almost a fifth of what I earn in a month, so I am not risking it on an unknown.
objection: Who else uses it? I cannot find any company I know. If it breaks or they disappear, I lose my client list.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or competitor in my city telling me they use it and showing it working, plus a trial long enough to try it with my real clients.
